name: ZCC_TB_CALL_HISTORY
description: This table is used for call history.

columns.name: TB_CALL_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Unique call identifier for the call

columns.name: AGENT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Agent identifier

columns.name: DIRECTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicate the call is inbound or outbound.

columns.name: ANI
columns.description: ANI

columns.name: DNIS
columns.description: DNIS

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: FK to ZMM_INTER_INTERACTIONS

columns.name: ANSWERED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate if call is answered or not. Y is answered. N is missed. Default value is N

columns.name: CALL_COMPLETED_FLAG
columns.description: indicate if call is completed.

columns.name: CALL_START_TIME
columns.description: The date and time the call started.

columns.name: CALL_END_TIME
columns.description: The date and time the call ends.

columns.name: CALLER_ID
columns.description: Caller id with which the call is associated. Default value is UNKNOWN.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description:
Id of the customer with which the call is associated. 
This information will be used when agents call back.

columns.name: CONTACT_ID
columns.description:
Id of the contact with which the call is associated. 
This information will be used when agents call back.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Id of relationship between customer and contact.

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_OBJECT_UID
columns.description:
ID of the ZMM Object, from the Objects Metadata. It will hold consuming product table's information, and corresponding ObjectId is retrieved using Objects Metadata. 
This information will be used when agents call back.

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description:
ID of the ZMM Object Type, from the Objects Metadata. It will hold consuming product table's information, and corresponding Object Type is retrieved using Objects Metadata. 
This information will be used when agents call back.

columns.name: OBJECT_WEB_APP_CODE
columns.description:
Web application code of ZMM Object. This is required to create zmm interaction record.
This information will be used when agents call back.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
